settings.title: Max Commits
settings.description: Number of commits loaded in the graph at once (more can be loaded on demand).

settings.title: Show Stashes
settings.description: Show stash entries in the Commit Graph.

settings.title: Avatars
settings.description: Show author pictures in the commit graph.

settings.title: Layout
settings.description: Preferred layout of the Commit Graph (same as GitLens' gitlens.graph.layout).

settings.title: Status Bar Enabled
settings.description: Show a 'Graph' button in the status bar (like GitLens).

settings.title: Pipelines
settings.description: Show the CI status (Azure Pipelines / GitHub Actions) of the commits in the Commit Graph.

settings.title: Inline Enabled
settings.description: Show blame of the current line at the end of the line.

settings.title: Inline Format
settings.description: Inline blame format. Placeholders: ${author}, ${ago}, ${date}, ${message}, ${sha}.

settings.title: Status Bar Enabled
settings.description: Show blame of the current line in the status bar.

settings.title: Show Editor Title Button
settings.description: Show the 'Toggle File Blame' button in the editor title bar.

settings.title: Toggle Mode
settings.description: How 'Toggle File Blame' behaves (same as GitLens' blame toggle mode).

settings.title: Enabled
settings.description: Show GitLens-style blame CodeLens (most recent change and authors) above the file and its classes/functions.

settings.title: Scopes
settings.description: Where to show blame CodeLens: 'document' = top of file, 'containers' = classes/modules, 'blocks' = functions/methods.

settings.title: Avatars
settings.description: Show author pictures in blame hovers.

settings.title: Auto Stage All
settings.description: Commit all changes without asking when nothing is staged (Changes view).

settings.title: Commit Message Instructions
settings.description: Extra instructions for the ✨ generated commit messages, e.g. `Write in French` or `Use Conventional Commits`.

settings.title: Commit Message Model
settings.description: Language model family for the ✨ commit messages (e.g. `gpt-4o-mini`, `claude-sonnet-4`). Empty: a fast Copilot model.

settings.title: Ticket Reminder
settings.description: Before committing on a branch that has no ticket, offer to link one (main, dev, release/* and hotfix/* are never asked about).

settings.title: Pull Rebase
settings.description: Pull with --rebase from the Changes view.

settings.title: Explain Instructions
settings.description: Extra instructions for ✨ Explain, e.g. `Answer in French`.

settings.title: Template
settings.description: Branch name template when starting work on a ticket. Placeholders: ${prefix}, ${id}, ${title}, ${user}.

settings.title: Prefix By Type
settings.description: Branch prefix per ticket type. Unknown types use 'feature'.

settings.title: Fetch Before Create
settings.description: Fetch the remote before creating a branch from a ticket.

settings.title: Sources
settings.description: Azure DevOps projects the tickets come from, when they are not in the repository's project (e.g. a shared backlog). Empty = the repository's project. Easiest with **Gitland: Ticket Sources…** (⚙ in the Tickets view).

settings.title: Status Bar Enabled
settings.description: Show the ticket of the current branch in the status bar (click to see it).

settings.title: Draft By Default
settings.description: Create pull requests as draft by default.

settings.title: Status Bar Enabled
settings.description: Show the pull request of the current branch in the status bar (click to see it).

settings.title: Add Me As Reviewer
settings.description: Add yourself as an optional reviewer of the pull requests you create (Azure DevOps).

settings.title: Description Instructions
settings.description: Extra instructions for the ✨ generated pull request title and description, e.g. `Write in French`.

settings.title: Status Bar Enabled
settings.description: Show the CI status of the current branch in the status bar.

settings.title: Default Style
settings.description: Picture used when an author has no profile photo (a real Azure DevOps / GitHub / Gravatar photo always wins). Drawn locally in the graph colors, or from [DiceBear](https://www.dicebear.com) or Gravatar. Preview them with **Gitland: Choose Author Picture Style**.

settings.title: Wiql
settings.default: SELECT [System.Id] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project AND [System.AssignedTo] = @Me AND [System.State] NOT IN ('Closed', 'Done', 'Removed', 'Resolved', 'Completed') ORDER BY [System.ChangedDate] DESC
settings.description: WIQL query used to list 'My Tickets' in Azure DevOps.

settings.title: Activate On Start Work
settings.description: Move the Azure DevOps work item to the 'Active' state when you start work on it.

settings.title: Browser Sign In
settings.description: Sign in to Azure DevOps through the browser instead of the Windows account dialog (sets 'microsoft-authentication.implementation' to 'msal-no-broker'). The Windows dialog is often blocked on laptops not managed by the organization.

settings.title: Releases Notes Instructions
settings.description: Extra instructions for the ✨ release notes, e.g. `Write in French`.

values.azureDevOps.wiql: SELECT [System.Id] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project AND [System.AssignedTo] = @Me AND [System.State] NOT IN ('Closed', 'Done', 'Removed', 'Resolved', 'Completed') ORDER BY [System.ChangedDate] DESC
